 Nagpur, Oct 31 (PTI) Right-arm medium pacer Aditya Thakare has replaced Yash Thakur, who will be away on national duties, in Vidarbha’s squad for the fourth round Ranji Trophy match against Madhya Pradesh starting on November 2.
 The two-time Ranji Trophy winners Vidarbha will host Madhya Pradesh here at the VCA Stadium in Jamtha in their Elite Group A clash, looking to maintain their winning run.
 Thakur has been named in the Indian squad for the fourth and fifth ODIs in New Zealand, making him unavailable for this round.
 Show Full Article
 The 2023-24 finalists Vidarbha have won each of their three matches against Goa, Jammu and Kashmir and Puducherry so far, collecting 19 points and are perched atop the points table.
 Squad: Akshay Wadkar (captain & wicket-keeper), Aman Mokhade, Aditya Thakare, Danish Malewar, Atharva Taide, Satyam Bhoyar, Yash Kadam, Harsh Dubey, Parth Rekhade, Mandar Mahale, Shivam Deshmukh (wk), Nachiket Bhute, Praful Hinge, Darshan Nalkande, Rajnessh Gurbani, Dhruv Shorey, R Samarth, Ganesh Bhosale. PTI DDV UNG
